future_removal_basis: Define the supported startup paths to which removal would apply and enforce authenticated corrected library origins for each actual executable rather than Qt version alone.

Review a concrete guard removal change and its appropriately scoped visible/opaque/PDF-A/fill/background/transform/zero/tiny-width preservation evidence; existing passes remain reusable unless changed inputs invalidate them.
parent_acceptance: The separate retention decision completes the parent mitigation-review requirement. All delivered routes and verified pins remain qualified; arbitrary Qt and signed application bundles remain explicit limits. No guard deletion is executed.

production_control_contract.QGCustomPath: Omit only no-fill, nonopaque solid-pattern (including fully transparent) dashed noncosmetic strokes of width >= 0.0001 with transparent background, affine transform, known non-PDF/A QPdfWriter/QPrinter and empty public-stroker outline. Delegate all other paint paths.
production_control_contract.QGCustomRect: Omit rectangles for which both dimensions are zero (isNull), including translated null rectangles. Delegate ordinary, horizontal, vertical and negative rectangles, preserving the existing selection-state handling.
production_control_contract.direct_cpp_tests: Recording-engine C++ tests describe guard suppression and preservation. They were inspected as source only in this review; the retained 11 TestTechDrawGui Python tests per runtime do not establish execution of these C++ tests.
production_control_contract.native_material_snapshot: QGIPrimPath sets the effective m_pen/m_brush before delegating. Prospective item.pen() alone is not an exhaustive snapshot of every paint-time material; no exhaustive guard-on/off native material equivalence is claimed.

reasons: The eight exact delivered binary routes passed, including native exports with both guards bypassed. This demonstrates corrected Qt behavior for those routes, not coverage of arbitrary installed Qt.
FREECAD_QUALIFIED_QT_PREFIX is opt-in. Generic CMake and LibPack discovery can still select unqualified Qt and Python/PySide origins.
The correction preserves Qt versions: unpatched and corrected Qt 6.11.2 exist, and LibPack backports retain 6.11.1. Compile-time or runtime version gating cannot authenticate the correction.
QGCustomRect is used beyond PDF dimension frames and suppresses null rectangles on every painting engine. The retained PDF qualification does not justify deleting that behavior globally.
Existing native comparisons use the same module with both guards bypassed on baseline and corrected Qt. They are not a guard-on versus guard-off equivalence comparison on corrected Qt.
remaining_limits: The compared native module has both mitigations disabled in BOTH baseline and corrected Qt phases: there is no mitigation-on versus mitigation-off equivalence proof on corrected Qt.
Standalone Qt fill/background/transform/tiny/PDF-A cases establish corrected Qt behavior, not exhaustive production QGCustomPath paint coverage on every device/painter.
QGCustomRect returns for a null rectangle on every painter; retained qualification is PDF device coverage, not all on-screen/raster/other engine behavior.
Native palette null-frame baseline counts differ by platform; opacity determines stroker branch. Do not claim translucent-frame failure reproduced on opaque255 Linux/x64Windows palettes.
Historical Cocoa schemas remain valid in their own scope; later prospective/Windows face fields are not retrofitted.
Exact8 archive identities and recorded native loaded origins are qualified; arbitrary system Qt, ambient Python/private PySide copies and signed/repackaged application bundles are not.
Old raw sources/packages/runtime processes are not reexecuted. Current review reads existing JSON/smallsource only; no test/build/render/download/largearchiveSHA repeated.
Native control coverage is 12 stock scenarios per device. The full fill/background/tiny/perspective matrix is chiefly standalone Qt coverage, not exhaustive native TechDraw guard-on/off coverage.
Historical Cocoa receipts keep their older capture schema; later prospective and Windows face-readiness fields are not inferred.

Native null-frame baseline warnings depend on the actual text pen alpha. SDK x64 alpha 255 takes the opaque branch; SDK ARM64 alpha 228 takes the translucent branch. ARM64 has five affected cases and seven bare close/fill pairs per device, which are different counts.
QGCustomRect retention is not a new proof that every style/brush/painter combination for null rectangles has no visible ink.

No complete signed or repackaged FreeCAD application, arbitrary system Qt or bare SDK Python with unchanged private PySide Qt DLLs is admitted. Qualified SDK startup uses the documented Qt-first host.
Historical producer qualification/promotion fields and failed runs remain unchanged; specifically accepted passed stages are joined by the later qualification/delivery records.

assertions: Remaining operators/coordinates and retained RGBA identical baseline→corrected Qt per device; only bare unmatched h/f pairs removed.
Standalone visible-fill blue, opaque-background red, zero/tiny/cosmetic width scaling, perspective, opaque native dash and PDF/A controls preserved.
Native stock gap invisible while short-solid/long-dashed/Distance/theoretical-exact/zero-width visible controls remain; Area100mm2 and relocatedArea preserved.
Both QPdfWriter and stock QPrinter used; native cross-device pixel rounding is informational, per-device preservation required.

scope: Independent retention review of both production mitigations after exact supported dependency delivery; no production code change.
tracking: Retention completes this review; arbitrary Qt or future optional guard removal is not implicitly added as required work. Existing unrelated open beads remain unchanged.

validation.method: Reuse accepted qualification, inspect exact source and small retained receipts, independently review decision and documentation.
